name: Voice R-7 hosted credential, spend and tenant boundaries on app.papercusp.com (portal e2e, 2026-10-06 run 2)
command: P=~/.papercusp-workspaces/papercusp-workspace/.papercusp/apps/portal; S=./.papercusp/scratch; LOG=$S/r7-boundaries-run2.log; cd "$P" || exit 1; date -u +STARTED=%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ > "$LOG"; git rev-parse HEAD | sed 's/^/PORTAL_HEAD=/' >> "$LOG"; git status --porcelain -- e2e/portal-voice-hosted-boundaries.spec.ts playwright.config.ts apps/host/src/api.ts | sed 's/^/PORTAL_DIRTY=/' >> "$LOG"; PORTAL_VOICE_BOUNDARIES_E2E=1 PORTAL_VOICE_BOUNDARIES_EVIDENCE_OUT=$S/r7-boundaries-run2-receipt.json npx playwright test e2e/portal-voice-hosted-boundaries.spec.ts --reporter=list >> "$LOG" 2>&1; echo "RUN_EXIT=$?" >> "$LOG"; date -u +FINISHED=%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ >> "$LOG"; tail -12 "$LOG"
summary: portal/e2e/portal-voice-hosted-boundaries.spec.ts ran against the live hosted portal (https://app.papercusp.com) through the canonical portal playwright.config.ts with two freshly admitted TEST tenants: 3 passed, 0 failed, exit 0. Unauthenticated: /api/voice/elevenlabs/token 401; /api/voice/engines 401; /api/papercup-chat/conversations/boundary-probe/voice-session 401, no token minted. Engines advertised exactly {"elevenlabs":false,"livekit":true}. Retired /api/device/voice/turn GET+POST 404. Browser-delivered bodies scanned for secret patterns (46 responses, 2267523 bytes, twice): 0 findings. Tenant A start burst: 6 x 404 no-agent-id (hosted ElevenLabs fails closed, unconfigured per D-007), then 429 portal_voice_start_rate_limited Retry-After 60. Tenant B after A's burst: 404 no-agent-id (not throttled). 2 TEST users cleaned up.

assertions.evidence: PASSED in 611ms: [hosted voice boundaries (R-7)] credential: an unauthenticated caller reaches no voice surface
PASSED in 25.0s: [hosted voice boundaries (R-7)] engines: only hosted engines are advertised; the retired desktop-local route stays dead; no secret reaches the browser
PASSED in 14.4s: [hosted voice boundaries (R-7)] spend + tenant: the mint never returns a key, one tenant's burst is refused, and a second tenant is untouched
tenant A 46 responses/2267523 bytes, tenant B 46/2267523; patterns elevenlabs-sk_, openai-or-anthropic-sk-; findings 0
response field sets: error|hint|status / error|ok|retryAfterMs; tenant B error|hint|status
tenant B after tenant A's 429: 404 no-agent-id

disclosures: Secret scan is pattern-only (elevenlabs-sk_, openai-or-anthropic-sk-): no env file holding the hosted ElevenLabs key was reachable from the run, so an exact-value comparison did not run (secretEnvChecked=[]).

Hosted ElevenLabs has no agent id configured (hosted EL is out of release scope per D-007), so every start fails closed with 404 no-agent-id before any token exists. Live cross-tenant token distinctness is therefore unmeasured (tokensCompared=false); it is covered at the unit layer by portal/tests/a-shared-mint-is-not-a-shared-token.test.ts.
The hosted spoken round trip and browser microphone denial are not exercised here; per D-009 they run in the guided real-microphone session (D-005).

The run used the portal working tree at 0504fc459d775e3f1e49cd2f99f89920fbf94c93 with the new spec untracked and playwright.config.ts modified (sourceDirtyAtRun); sourceFiles records the exact bytes that ran.
